snippet.title: Pokémon Aesthetic Red - A Visual and Musical Overhaul of Fire Red
snippet.description:
Pokémon Aesthetic Red is a Fire Red GBA ROM hack that reimagines the Kanto journey with a complete visual and musical overhaul. Explore an open-world Kanto and the Sevii Islands with vibrant DS inspired graphics, a brand new soundtrack, modern QoL and new features!

What this hack offers:
• Complete Visual & Musical Overhaul with vibrant graphics and a refreshing soundtrack
• Open-World Kanto and Sevii Islands: No HM restrictions, Gyms can be challenged in any order
• All Gen 1-2 Pokémon available with related evolutions
• New Features: Reusable TMs, Portable PC, Infinite Rare Candy, Wonder Trade, Move Tutors and more! Optional Level Scaling, Level Caps, Doubles Mode and Randomizer
• Rebalanced Gameplay: New Base Stats, Abilities, Learnsets, Type Changes and more (Faithful Version available if you don't want rebalancing)
• Increased Difficulty: Improved AI and Trainers, reimagined Gym Leaders & Boss Trainers

Download & More Info: https://pokecommunity.com/threads/539365/

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/ApM4sW9qSv
See our other releases and socials here: http://linktr.ee/LibertyTwins

We hope you enjoy playing Aesthetic Red. Thanks for playing, and your support means a lot!
#pokemon #pokemonromhack #pokemonfangame
